about: SCRUM-1075: the 14 incentive clause wordings on the park group's HR profiles (no names) and their readings as decided on staging on 26 November 2026. Stream keys are staging's; `streams` maps them onto the prototype's seed world, where `revenue`, `counts` and `units` are staging's typed ZZ TEST October figures.

wordings.text: 10 baht per returned flyer, devided by the Sale Booth Team

parts.quote: 10 baht per returned flyer, devided by the Sale Booth Team
parts.plainWords: Booth voucher bonus at 10 baht per used voucher, counted from the booth and till records. Paid in full to each person named on the voucher (owner, 28 November 2026); the contract wording says divided by the team.

reading.summary: Booth voucher bonus at 10 baht per used voucher, counted from the booth and till records. Paid in full to each person named on the voucher (owner, 28 November 2026); the contract wording says divided by the team.

wordings.text: 15 baht per returned flyer, devided by the Sale Booth Team

parts.quote: 15 baht per returned flyer, devided by the Sale Booth Team
parts.plainWords: Booth voucher bonus at 15 baht per used voucher, counted from the booth and till records. Paid in full to each person named on the voucher (owner, 28 November 2026); the contract wording says divided by the team.

reading.summary: Booth voucher bonus at 15 baht per used voucher, counted from the booth and till records. Paid in full to each person named on the voucher (owner, 28 November 2026); the contract wording says divided by the team.

wordings.text: + Service Charge After 3 month salary rises to 20 000 thb
wordings.why: Decided on staging: not an incentive (service charge and a salary change are not bonuses).

parts.plainWords: Service charge is paid out under the branch's own service-charge policy, not as a bonus calculated from this clause.

parts.quote: After 3 month salary rises to 20 000 thb
parts.plainWords: This is a salary increase to THB 20,000 after 3 months, which HR handles as a pay change, not a monthly bonus.

reading.summary: The employee receives service charge under the branch's service-charge policy, and after 3 months their salary increases to THB 20,000. Neither item is a bonus payroll calculates from this clause.
questions: From which date do the 3 months run, so HR knows when the salary rises to THB 20,000?

wordings.text: Nanny and Drop-Off Service bonuses, shared among the Childcare Team based on days worked.

parts.quote: Nanny and Drop-Off Service bonuses, shared among the Childcare Team based on days worked.
parts.plainWords: The employee takes part in the Childcare Team's nanny and drop-off bonus pool. The pool is divided among the team according to days worked, and the pool's own approved terms set the amount.

reading.summary: The employee joins the existing Childcare Team bonus pool for nanny and drop-off service, which is shared among the team by days worked. The clause itself states no rate, so it is handled by joining the approved team pool (20% of nanny and drop-off sales, shared by Childcare Team by days worked).
questions: Is this the same bonus as the approved pool '20% of nanny and drop-off sales, shared by Childcare Team by days worked'?
Who are the members of the Childcare Team for this pool?
Should the pool cover nanny and drop-off sales at both parks or only the employee's own park?

rules.name: Contract · 20% of nanny and drop-off sales, shared by Childcare Team by days worked

wordings.text: 0,2% of total revenue if revenue is over 4,5 mln thb

parts.quote: 0,2% of total revenue if revenue is over 4,5 mln thb
parts.plainWords: Pay 0.2% of total monthly sales (all sales streams, excluding the service charge pool) in any month where those sales exceed THB 4,500,000. If sales are 4,500,000 or less, nothing is paid for this part.

reading.summary: Pays the employee 0.2% of total monthly sales, but only in months where that total sales figure exceeds THB 4,500,000. Nothing is paid in months at or below that level.
questions: Does "total revenue" mean the combined sales of both parks, or only the employee's own park?
Should "total revenue" include all sales streams (birthday, drop-off, nanny, special events, tickets) and exclude the service charge pool?
Is the same total used for the THB 4.5 million threshold as for the 0.2% calculation?
Is 0.2% correct for this employee, given other clauses with the same 4.5 million threshold use 0.4% and 0.002%?

rules.name: Contract · 0.2% of total revenue, when above 4,500,000

wordings.text: 2% of all Birthday Revenue, 2,5% of all special event revenue. Company pays for housing, 28 000.

parts.plainWords: Pays 2% of birthday revenue each month. Read as all parks' birthday revenue unless confirmed otherwise.
Pays 2,5% of special event revenue each month. Read as all parks' special event revenue unless confirmed otherwise.
Housing paid by the company, 28 000. This is a benefit, not an incentive payroll calculates from this clause.

reading.summary: The employee earns 2% of all birthday party revenue plus 2,5% of all special event revenue each month. The company also pays 28 000 for housing, which is a benefit handled outside payroll incentives.
questions: Does "all Birthday Revenue" mean both parks combined, or only the employee's own park?
Does "all special event revenue" mean both parks combined, or only the employee's own park?

rules.name: Contract · 2.5% of all special event revenue

wordings.text: 1% of all Birthday Revenue, 2% of all special event revnue
wordings.why: Only person with this clause has left and has no payroll profile, so it cannot be approved.

parts.plainWords: Pays 1% of birthday party sales (excluding VAT and service charge) each month. Earned by this employee alone, with no minimum and no cap.
Pays 2% of special event sales (excluding VAT and service charge) each month. Earned by this employee alone, with no minimum and no cap.

reading.summary: The employee earns 1% of birthday revenue plus 2% of special event revenue each month, with no threshold or cap, earned alone.
questions: Does "all Birthday Revenue" mean both parks combined, or only the employee's own park?
Does "all special event revnue" mean both parks combined, or only the employee's own park?

wordings.why: Decided on staging: not an incentive (service charge and a salary change are not bonuses).

parts.plainWords: The employee gets a share of service charge. This is paid through the branch's standard service-charge policy, not as a bonus calculated from this clause.

reading.summary: The clause only states that the employee receives service charge. Service charge is paid under the branch's own service-charge policy, so payroll calculates no incentive from this clause.

wordings.text: 20% of Nanny and Drop Off revenue to be devided as a bonus between all working nanny's and activity hosts
wordings.why: Only person with this clause has left and has no payroll profile, so it cannot be approved; the pool is also split equally, which payroll cannot do for a sales pool.

bonus.team: all working nanny's and activity hosts

parts.quote: 20% of Nanny and Drop Off revenue to be devided as a bonus between all working nanny's and activity hosts
parts.plainWords: Each month payroll takes 20% of nanny revenue plus drop-off revenue and divides that pool between all working nannies and activity hosts. There is no minimum and no maximum.

reading.summary: Pays a bonus pool of 20% of nanny and drop-off revenue, shared between all working nannies and activity hosts.
questions: Should the nanny and drop-off revenue be taken from both parks combined, or only from the employee's own park?
Who exactly counts as "all working nanny's and activity hosts" for this pool each month?
Is the pool split equally, or should it be shared by days worked as in the other childcare clause?
Is 20% of nanny and drop-off revenue correct, as it is far higher than the other revenue-share rates in use?

wordings.text: + Service Charge + Nanny and drop off service bonus

parts.plainWords: Service charge is paid out under the branch's own service-charge policy, not calculated by payroll from this clause.

parts.quote: + Nanny and drop off service bonus
parts.plainWords: 20% of nanny and drop-off sales, one pool shared by the Childcare Team by days worked.

reading.summary: Service charge is paid by the service-charge policy. The nanny and drop-off bonus is the Childcare Team pool: 20% of nanny and drop-off sales, shared by days worked (the rate of the park's own nanny clause).
questions: What rate or amount is the nanny and drop-off service bonus (for example a percent of nanny and drop-off revenue)?
Is this bonus earned by the employee alone, or is it one pool shared with a team, and if shared, which team and how is it split?
Which sales count for this bonus: nanny revenue, drop-off revenue, or both, and at which park(s)?

rules.name: Contract · 20% of nanny and drop-off sales, shared by Childcare Team by days worked

wordings.text: 30 baht per returned flyer, devided by the Sale Booth team
wordings.why: Only person with this clause has left and has no payroll profile, so it cannot be approved.

parts.quote: 30 baht per returned flyer, devided by the Sale Booth team
parts.plainWords: Booth voucher bonus at 30 baht per used voucher, counted from the booth and till records. Paid in full to each person named on the voucher (owner, 28 November 2026); the contract wording says divided by the team.

reading.summary: Booth voucher bonus at 30 baht per used voucher, counted from the booth and till records. Paid in full to each person named on the voucher (owner, 28 November 2026); the contract wording says divided by the team.

wordings.text: Monthly bonus of THB 400 per hosted birthday party, calculated based on the total number of birthday parties hosted during the month.

parts.quote: Monthly bonus of THB 400 per hosted birthday party, calculated based on the total number of birthday parties hosted during the month.
parts.plainWords: Pay 400 baht for every birthday party hosted during the month. The number of parties hosted is typed in each month.

reading.summary: Pays THB 400 for each birthday party hosted, counted from the total number of birthday parties hosted in the month. No threshold or cap is stated.
questions: Is the monthly count the park's total birthday parties, or only the parties this employee personally hosted?
If it is a park total, which park's parties are counted (the employee's own park or both parks)?
Does this employee keep the full 400 baht per party, or is it shared with a team?

rules.name: Contract · 400 baht per hosted birthday party

wordings.text: Monthly bonus of 0,4% of total revenue, provided that the combined monthly revenue of both parks exceeds THB 4.5 million

revenue.described: total revenue, combined over both parks

parts.quote: Monthly bonus of 0,4% of total revenue, provided that the combined monthly revenue of both parks exceeds THB 4.5 million
parts.plainWords: Pay 0.4% of the combined total revenue of both parks. Pay nothing in a month where that combined revenue is 4,500,000 baht or less.

reading.summary: Pays the employee 0.4% of total revenue of both parks each month, but only in a month when the two parks' combined revenue is more than THB 4,500,000.
questions: Does "total revenue" mean all sales streams (birthday, drop-off, nanny, special events, tickets and other sales) with the service charge pool excluded?
Should the 4.5 million threshold be tested on the same combined total revenue that the 0.4% is paid on?
Other clauses use 0,2% and 0,002% of total revenue with the same 4.5 million condition — is 0,4% correct for this employee?

rules.name: Contract · 0.4% of total revenue, combined over both parks, when above 4,500,000

wordings.text: Monthly bonus of 0,002% of total revenue, provided that the combined monthly revenue of both parks exceeds THB 4.5 million
wordings.why: Held for the owner: 0,002% pays 90 baht at the 4.5 million threshold; the rate is to be confirmed.

revenue.described: total revenue of both parks combined

parts.quote: Monthly bonus of 0,002% of total revenue, provided that the combined monthly revenue of both parks exceeds THB 4.5 million
parts.plainWords: Pays 0.002% of the two parks' combined sales for the month. Nothing is paid unless those combined sales are above THB 4,500,000.

reading.summary: A monthly bonus of 0.002% of the combined total sales of both parks, paid only in months when that combined total exceeds THB 4,500,000. The employee earns it alone.
questions: Is the rate really 0,002% (other clauses for the same kind of bonus use 0,4% and 0,2%)?
Does "total revenue" mean all sales streams (birthday, drop-off, nanny, special events, tickets) and exclude the service charge pool?
At exactly 4,500,000 baht, 0.002% pays 90 baht a month. Please confirm the rate really is 0.002%.
